title: Implement update migration readiness and rollback flow
description: Replace source-tree update behavior with a pinned-artifact update flow that migrates data safely, verifies readiness, and rolls back on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Update accepts a pinned release version and never builds source on the VPS
The existing database/schema state is backed up before migration or cutover
Migration failure or readiness failure leaves the previous active release serving and records an actionable error
A successful update preserves data, updates the active release atomically, and reports old/new versions
Rollback can select the previous verified release without deleting mutable data

steps.details: Simulate successful update, migration failure, readiness failure, and explicit rollback against a temporary deployment fixture.
Refactor `scripts/update.sh` to verify/download/deploy a release artifact and stop using `git reset --hard` plus `npm ci`/`npm run build` in the production path.
Run the existing database migration/seed contract from the staged runtime, with backup and clear failure output.
Switch the active pointer back to the prior manifest, restart/readiness-check the service, and preserve diagnostic evidence.
Run all update/rollback fixtures and shell syntax checks.

technicalNotes: The current update script is a source rebuild and destructive reset; this task is a root-cause replacement, not a cosmetic flag.
